items.title: Alicia Olatuja interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 9, 2018
items.q: my teacher, Mrs. Marge, I still remember her

ctx.x: Did you have sort of an aha moment as a youth with a recording or something in church?

More oh no, than aha. But I will say that I think aha moments come when you realize that someone believes in you. I think that was my aha moment. And you kind of just put together a bunch of different aha moments until you actually say okay, this is what I’m going to do. So I’d say my first aha moment was when I was in kindergarten and they used to play “The Star Spangled Banner” over the intercom. And I would stand up and just be like so proud. And we could sing along if we wanted to, and I sang along, real…
Well spell it and maybe it will help.
